dashboard.title: Multi-country warehouse inventory
dashboard.intro: Track stock across warehouses in different countries and cities. The Angular client talks to the ASP.NET Core Web API, which persists everything in SQLite through EF Core. External systems such as the eCommerce storefront post their updates to the same API.

cards.warehouses: Register warehouses in each country and city, and keep their details current.
cards.stockMovements: Audit every inbound, outbound and manual adjustment with its source.
cards.locations: Manage the countries and cities that warehouses belong to.

flow.title: How an update travels
flow.step1: The Angular UI or an external system calls a Web API endpoint.
flow.step2: The service validates the request and applies the stock change.
flow.step3: EF Core writes the inventory row and a stock movement row to SQLite.
flow.step4: Every change keeps its source and reference, so the stock history always explains where a number came from.
